verdict.rationale: mParticle documents its own Data Subject Request API, now at v3 with a dedicated opendsr endpoint, which points to a first-party mechanism for handling data-subject requests such as deletion. The pack never explicitly describes deletion behavior, and it contains no retention controls. The consent and opt-out forwarding rules are an adjacent feature and get no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the DSR API performs erasure, configurable data retention periods or policies, deletion scope and timelines, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Follow the steps below to upgrade from version 1 or version 2 to version 3. Update to the v3 base URL https://opendsr.mparticle.com/v3
